title: Tandoori-style drumsticks with rice and raita
description: Bone-in drumsticks in a tandoori yogurt marinade, roasted until charred, with rice and a cucumber-mint raita.
freeze_note: Freeze the drumsticks and rice; make the raita fresh.
draft_note: Draft quantities: adjust them in the app. Freeze the chicken and rice; make the raita fresh.

steps.text: Slash the drumsticks to the bone in 2 or 3 places. Grate the garlic, ginger and cucumber; chop the mint.
Mix the whole-milk yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, paprika, chili powder, garam masala, half the cumin, oil and 1 1/4 tsp of the salt. Coat the drumsticks and marinate at least 1 hour.
Bring 540 ml of water to a boil, add the rinsed rice, cover and simmer on low 15 minutes. Rest off the heat 10 minutes, then fluff.
Roast on a rack over a lined sheet at 425F for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until charred and cooked through to the bone.
Stir the Greek yogurt with the cucumber, mint, the remaining cumin and salt for the raita.
Divide the rice and drumsticks among 4 containers; pack the raita separately.
Cool, then refrigerate in the containers.
Reheat covered, stirring halfway, until hot all the way through.
